description: Polygons of a layer whose bounding box meets a tile. One Arrow IPC stream, one record batch.

fields.name: object_id
fields.description: Object id, 0 <= id < 2^53. May repeat across tiles.

fields.name: coords
fields.description: x, y interleaved, level-0 px; exterior ring then holes; rings not closed (no repeated first vertex).

fields.name: holes
fields.description: Vertex index (within this polygon) where each hole ring starts; empty without holes.

fields.name: triangles
fields.description: Earcut triangle indices into this polygon's vertices, 3 per triangle.
